$description: BatataBit design tokens (W3C DTCG). Primitives hold raw values; semantic tokens alias primitives and say WHEN to use them. Components must consume semantic tokens. Source of truth: scripts/build-tokens.mjs turns this file into src/styles/tokens.css.

orange.$description: Primitive brand orange scale. 500 = Figma 'Bitcoin Orange', 100 = Figma 'Soft Orange' (#FFE9D4, canonical value from Figma).

neutral.$description: Primitive warm-neutral scale. 900 = Figma 'Warm Black', 800 = 'Warm Black+1', 300 = 'Grey', 50 = 'Off White', 0 = 'Just White'. 600 and 500 are the two mid-greys that were hardcoded in the CSS (#757575, #808080); they are not in Figma.

green.$description: Primitive success green. Only used by the trending-up SVG today; not in Figma.

red.$description: Primitive danger red. Only used by the trending-down SVG today; not in Figma.

primary.$description: Brand orange. Use for accent text on light surfaces (table titles), badges/highlights, the footer background and the outline of secondary CTA buttons. Never use as body-text colour: contrast on off-white is 2.17:1 (fails WCAG AA). White text on it also fails (2.3:1); see color.on-primary.

primary-soft.$description: Light orange tint. Use as a soft background for chips/pills (e.g. the 'Actualizado' date chip) and as the lead-paragraph text colour over the dark-to-orange hero gradient. Pair chip text with color.text-on-soft.

secondary.$description: Brand blue. Use for accent text on light surfaces (the 'Comisiones' table title) and for the secondary badge background ('Más vendido'). Do not use for body text: contrast on off-white is 2.83:1.

secondary-soft.$description: Light blue tint. Use as a soft chip/pill background in the blue variant (e.g. the date chip of the 'Comisiones' table). Pair text with color.text-on-soft.

surface-dark.$description: Darkest surface. Use as the background of dark sections (product-detail block) and as the dark end of gradient.hero. Text on it: color.text-on-dark or color.text-muted-on-dark.

surface-dark-raised.$description: Surface raised one step above color.surface-dark. Use for cards sitting on a dark section (feature cards). Not the page background.

surface-page.$description: Default light page background (main content area) and the fill of buttons placed on light or gradient backgrounds.

surface-card.$description: Pure white card/cell surface that sits on color.surface-page (plan cards, table cells).

text-strong.$description: Primary text colour on light surfaces: headings, prices, button labels. Contrast on off-white 14.25:1.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text on light surfaces (lead paragraphs, table values, small notes). Contrast is 4.61:1 on white but 4.35:1 on off-white (fails AA on off-white); candidate to darken in a later phase.

text-muted-on-dark.$description: Secondary text on dark surfaces (section lead, feature-card body). Contrast 3.82:1 on surface-dark-raised and 4.21:1 on surface-dark (fails AA); candidate to lighten later.

text-on-dark.$description: Primary text on dark surfaces and on the hero gradient: headings, card titles, links on dark. Not for text on orange; use color.on-primary.

text-on-soft.$description: Text drawn over color.primary-soft or color.secondary-soft chips. Contrast ≈14:1.

text-subtle.$description: Decorative/de-emphasised text on white (the label column of data tables). Contrast on white is 1.94:1 (fails AA); do not use for essential information.

on-primary.$description: Text/icons placed on color.primary or color.secondary fills (badges, footer links). Currently white to preserve the original look, but it fails WCAG AA (2.3:1 on orange, 3.0:1 on blue); intended to change to a dark neutral in a later, deliberate phase.

trend-up.$description: Positive-change indicator (price up). Currently consumed only by the trending-up SVG; becomes available to the Icon component in Phase 3. Always pair with a text/aria alternative; colour alone is not enough.

trend-down.$description: Negative-change indicator (price down). Currently consumed only by the trending-down SVG. Always pair with a text/aria alternative.

size.$description: Font sizes in rem on the 62.5% root (1rem = 10px). The key is the pixel size.

line-height.$description: Line heights in rem on the 62.5% root. The key is the pixel size.

body.$description: Default font for all UI text (set on the root). Use unless a rule explicitly calls for font.data.

data.$description: Font for tabular/numeric data (currency tables). Use only inside data tables.

button.$description: Corner radius of filled buttons/links (hero CTA). Kept distinct from radius.button-outline (5px vs 4px) until they are deliberately unified.

button-outline.$description: Corner radius of outline buttons (plan CTA). Kept distinct from radius.button (4px vs 5px) until they are deliberately unified.

card.$description: Corner radius of large cards and table grids (plan cards, currency tables).

card-compact.$description: Corner radius of small cards on dark sections (feature cards).

chip.$description: Corner radius of chips, pills and badges (date chip, 'Recomendado' badge).

space.$description: Spacing scale (px, 4px grid). The key is the pixel size.

sombra-blanco.$description: Figma effect 'Sombra /Blanco' (#59491E29). Colour kept as rgba(...,0.16) rather than 8-digit hex (alpha 0x29 = 0.1608) so rendering stays pixel-identical to the original CSS.

sombra-negro.$description: Figma effect 'Sombra /Negro' (#00000029). Colour kept as rgba(0,0,0,0.16) for pixel parity with the original CSS.

on-light.$description: Elevation shadow for elements on light surfaces (buttons, plan cards). Warm-tinted. Figma: 'Sombra /Blanco'.

on-dark.$description: Elevation shadow for elements on dark surfaces (feature cards). Neutral black. Figma: 'Sombra /Negro'.

hero.$description: Hero background: diagonal gradient from dark (top-right) to brand orange (bottom-left). Use only for the page hero/header. Figma: 'Linear BG'. Angle 207.8deg is stored in $extensions because DTCG gradients have no angle; Figma stops/angle are still unverified (AUDIT §11).

heading-lg.$description: Page and section headings (h1, h2). Mobile 24/26 is applied now; tablet+ 40/42 is defined for Phase 5 and not yet applied. Both bold 700. Figma: 'H1 Mobile' / 'H1 Tablet+'.

mobile.$description: Heading at viewport < 930px. Use for h1/h2.

tablet.$description: Heading at viewport ≥ 930px (Phase 5; not applied yet).

lead.$description: Lead/subtitle paragraph placed directly under a heading. Mobile 14/18 is applied now; tablet+ 20/24 defined for Phase 5. Both medium 500. Figma: 'H2 Mobile' / 'H2 Tablet+' (it is a paragraph style, not an h2).

tablet.$description: Lead paragraph at viewport ≥ 930px (Phase 5; not applied yet).

body-sm.$description: Small running text inside cards and lists: feature-card body, plan title, footer link list. Same values as text.lead.mobile but does NOT scale at tablet+.

button.$description: Label of any button or CTA link. Bold 14/18. (The hero link uses only size and weight; its line-height is left to the browser to keep the original rendering.)

lead-tight.$description: Legacy variant of text.lead with a tighter 16px line-height, used only by the exchange-section lead. Candidate to merge into text.lead; kept separate now for pixel parity.

title-md.$description: Title above a data table ('Monedas', 'Comisiones'). Bold 18/23 in the data font.

title-sm.$description: Title of a feature card. Bold 18/18 (line-height equals font-size; tight, single-line titles only).

data.$description: Cell text in data tables (labels and values). Regular 16/19 in the data font.

caption.$description: Small supporting text: date chips, badges, price currency symbol, savings note. Light 300 / 12/15. Some uses take only the size.

price.$description: Large price figure on a plan card. Bold 52/53.
